description: Hand-labelled questions over the fictional Northwind sample corpus in evaluation/datasets/sample_corpus. Each relevant passage is a verbatim snippet from the documents.

items.question: How much notice does the customer need to give to terminate the agreement for convenience?
relevant_passages: terminate this Agreement for convenience upon ninety (90) days prior written notice
items.reference_answer: The Customer may terminate for convenience upon ninety (90) days prior written notice.

items.question: What happens if a party materially breaches the contract?
relevant_passages: terminate this Agreement for material breach if the breach is not cured within thirty (30) days
items.reference_answer: Either party may terminate for material breach if the breach is not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice.

items.question: What is the annual subscription fee?
items.reference_answer: The annual subscription fee is 120,000 USD, invoiced annually in advance.

items.question: How quickly must invoices be paid and what is the late payment interest?
relevant_passages: Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date
items.reference_answer: Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days; late payments accrue interest at 1.5 percent per month.

items.question: What uptime does the provider commit to and what credits apply?
relevant_passages: available 99.9 percent of the time in each calendar month
items.reference_answer: The Services are available 99.9 percent of the time each month; credits are 10 percent of the monthly fee below 99.9 percent and 25 percent below 99.0 percent.

items.question: Which encryption standards protect customer data?
relevant_passages: encrypt Customer Data at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher
items.reference_answer: Customer Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher.

items.question: How fast must customers be told about a personal data breach?
relevant_passages: within forty-eight (48) hours of becoming aware of it
Personal data breaches are notified to affected customers within 48 hours
items.reference_answer: Customers must be notified without undue delay and within 48 hours.

items.question: Where is customer data stored?
relevant_passages: stored and processed only in data centres located in the European Union
items.reference_answer: Only in data centres located in the European Union unless the Customer consents otherwise.

items.question: What is the cap on each party's liability?
relevant_passages: shall not exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the event
items.reference_answer: Liability is capped at the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event, except for confidentiality, data protection and indemnification.

items.question: How long is the minimum password length?
relevant_passages: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long
items.reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

items.question: How often are access rights reviewed?
relevant_passages: Managers review the access rights of their team members every quarter
items.reference_answer: Managers review access every quarter; production access is reviewed monthly by the security team.

items.question: Within what time must critical vulnerabilities be patched?
relevant_passages: Critical vulnerabilities in internet-facing systems must be patched within 7 days
items.reference_answer: Critical vulnerabilities in internet-facing systems must be patched within 7 days.

items.question: How frequently are production databases backed up and how long are backups kept?
relevant_passages: Production databases are backed up every 6 hours
items.reference_answer: Every 6 hours, with encrypted backups retained for 35 days in a separate region.

items.question: How many days of paid annual leave do employees get?
relevant_passages: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year
items.reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per year.

items.question: How many days per week can employees work from home?
relevant_passages: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week
items.reference_answer: Up to three days per week with manager approval.

items.question: What is the parental leave for primary caregivers?
relevant_passages: Primary caregivers receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave
items.reference_answer: Primary caregivers receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave.

items.question: What is the annual learning budget per employee?
items.reference_answer: Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1,500 EUR.

items.question: When must lost laptops be reported?
relevant_passages: Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to IT within 24 hours
items.reference_answer: Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to IT within 24 hours.
